name: Yoka
source:
You play as a dream agent who must enter a dream world, find the host, and shut it down before it becomes more corrupted.

[From [url=https://yagi-sakaguchi.itch.io/yoka]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一名梦想特工，必须进入梦想世界，找到主机，并在它变得更加腐败之前将其关闭。

[来自[url=https://yagi-sakaguchi.itch.io/yoka]Itch.io[/url]]
